title: Universal Asset Picker / Resource Query API
objective: Prepare the bounded Universal Asset Picker / Resource Query API only after a governed start: expose one reusable query/picker surface over existing ARI catalog truth, reusing ARI-15 pagination/lazy retrieval and applying availability and rights/capability filtering without minting owner-domain semantics.

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-11
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-18 is completed_verified; its native/CAPP/PAPT registration bridge is closed.
ARI-19 is selected only and has no implementation branch or implementation authority.
ARI-19 must reuse ARI-15 query/pagination/lazy-retrieval primitives rather than create a second query engine.
Availability and rights/use-capability filtering must occur before eligible choices are exposed; denied, revoked, missing and unknown states remain explicit and fail closed where required.
MAI, AAI, CAPP, PAPT and other owner-domain semantics remain owner-owned; ARI-19 returns stable references/projections only.
ARI-20 and all later ARI implementation remain inactive until ARI-19 is completed_verified.
next_action: Record a governed ARI-19 start projection before creating the reserved branch, then execute only the bounded query/picker tranche through focused regression, exact-head validation, merge and closeout.
